output.subject: We've received your complaint about your Riverside Drive branch visit
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us about your recent visit to our Riverside Drive branch. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know it has been recorded as you described it.

You told us that you waited about 45 minutes with only one teller window open, and that when you reached the counter, the teller was rude to you and would not cash your check without a second form of ID. You mentioned that you asked to speak with a manager and were told none was available. You also told us that you were charged two overdraft fees relating to the same check.

We understand you would like a call back from the branch manager, and we have noted that request.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days. We're sorry for the frustration this visit has caused you, and we appreciate you taking the time to let us know.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Decide whether a manager call back will be arranged; the draft only notes the request and does not promise one.
The representative told the customer the feedback would be forwarded to the branch manager; confirm this happened before sending.
Check the account for two overdraft fees tied to check #1102 and decide on any action; the draft makes no commitment.
The teller's name and the check number are deliberately left out of the reply; add them only if appropriate.
Consider whether the overdraft fee issue needs separate handling from the branch service complaint.
The complaint came from a call-center note, so verify the details with the customer's own account if needed.
